historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Evoque P250 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the P250 launched in the Evoque lineup, it replaced the Ford-sourced Si4 badge, introducing Jaguar Land Rover’s in-house Ingenium 2.0-litre petrol architecture. Delivering 247hp, it offered a refined, punchy alternative to the problematic diesel models, eventually integrating 48V mild-hybrid technology in the second generation.

milestones.description: PT204 (2.0L, 247hp) introduced to the L538 facelift, replacing the older EcoBoost-derived Si4 with JLR's modular Ingenium petrol engine.

The all-new L551 second-generation Evoque launches. The P250 badge continues but is now paired with a 48V Belt-integrated Starter Generator (BiSG) for MHEV efficiency and smoother stop-start refinement.
Present - Continuous software and thermal management refinements to the Ingenium P250, maintaining its position as the premier petrol option in the Evoque range.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque P250 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Evoque P250 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The PT204 and AJ20P4 Ingenium petrol engines dominating the Range Rover Evoque P250 are generally more reliable than their diesel counterparts, avoiding oil dilution and DPF issues. However, they remain susceptible to specific fuel system and timing component weaknesses. Rebuilt P250 engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: High-Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) Failure - Why the Range Rover Evoque P250 PT204 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: The camshaft-driven HPFP plunger suffers internal wear, shedding metal particles into the high-pressure fuel rail. This contaminates the injectors, causes lean misfires, and can ultimately lead to cylinder bore scoring if the engine runs lean under load.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the HPFP, fuel filter, and flushing the fuel rail before debris reaches the injectors.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly cost-effective if caught immediately after first starting issues or hesitation.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a fully rebuilt PT204/AJ20P4 with verified bore condition, new injectors, and a 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if metal debris has scored the cylinders or caused catastrophic bottom-end failure.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Modern Range Rover Evoque P250 values typically range from £12,000 to £38,000+ depending on generation (L538 vs L551), specification, and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. Because the vehicle worth is well above £10,000, a £2,000-£4,200 rebuilt engine replacement cost is typically small relative to the vehicle value ( Safe). Replacing the engine preserves the vehicle's usability, refinement, and strong market value.
problems.recommendation: If your Range Rover Evoque P250 hesitates on acceleration or throws fuel rail pressure codes, replace the HPFP immediately at a specialist (£600-£900) before debris spreads to the injectors. However, if the engine has suffered bore scoring from lean running or severe timing chain jump, a full rebuilt unit with upgraded components is the only reliable long-term solution.

items.question: How much does a Range Rover Evoque P250 engine replacement cost?
items.answer: A reconditioned or rebuilt PT204/AJ20P4 engine for the Evoque P250 typically costs between £1,800 and £4,200 for the supply-only unit in the UK.
keyPoints: Used P250 engines start around £1,500 but carry higher risk due to unknown HPFP and timing chain history.
Rebuilt units with updated tensioners sit at the £2,000-£4,200 mark.
Supply and fit labour will add £520-£780 depending on the specialist.
items.cta: -> Get free quotes for your Range Rover Evoque P250 engine replacement.

items.question: What are the signs of HPFP or timing chain failure in a Range Rover Evoque P250?
items.answer: The Ingenium petrol engine is prone to high-pressure fuel pump wear and occasional timing chain stretch. Watch for early warning signs before catastrophic failure.
keyPoints: Hesitation on acceleration, cold-start misfires, or a ticking noise from the HPFP area.
A distinct metallic rattling from the timing cover on cold starts, indicating tensioner wear.
Engine management lights indicating fuel rail pressure drops or cam/crank correlation faults.
items.cta: -> Compare specialist quotes to fix your Range Rover Evoque P250 engine issues.

items.question: Is it worth replacing the engine in a modern Range Rover Evoque P250?
items.answer: Yes, the Evoque P250 market holds its value exceptionally well, making a full engine replacement a financially sound decision compared to parting out.
keyPoints: Modern P250 models regularly sell for £12,000 to £38,000+.
A £2,000-£4,200 rebuilt engine preserves the vehicle's drivability, refinement, and market value.
items.cta: -> Check current Range Rover Evoque P250 replacement costs.

items.question: How long does a Range Rover Evoque P250 engine replacement take?
items.answer: Because the Ingenium petrol engine is densely packed and requires precise ECU coding (especially for L551 MHEV models), a specialist workshop requires specific JLR diagnostic tools.
keyPoints: Engine removal and refitting usually takes 8 to 12 hours of labour.
Total workshop turnaround is typically 3 to 5 working days, including ECU coding and adaptation.
items.cta: -> Find a local specialist for your Range Rover Evoque P250.

items.question: What is the difference between the Range Rover Evoque Si4 and P250 engines?
items.answer: While both produce similar power outputs (237hp vs 247hp), the P250 uses JLR's in-house Ingenium architecture, whereas the older Si4 used a Ford-derived EcoBoost block.
keyPoints: The P250 (PT204) offers smoother refinement, better emissions compliance, and a twin-scroll turbo setup.
The P250 in the L551 generation (2019+) also features 48V MHEV assistance for seamless stop-start and torque fill.
items.cta: -> Get quotes for the correct engine for your Range Rover Evoque P250.
